title: ReproResult
description: Schema for the output of a single paper's reproducibility assessment.

doi.description: Digital Object Identifier of the paper.

mae.description: Reproduced Mean Absolute Error. Null if calculation failed.

r2.description: Reproduced R-squared value. Null if calculation failed.

rho.description: Reproduced Spearman's Rho. Null if calculation failed.

deviation_mae.description: Absolute deviation of reproduced MAE from reported.

deviation_r2.description: Absolute deviation of reproduced R2 from reported.

deviation_rho.description: Absolute deviation of reproduced Rho from reported.

score_s.description: Reproducibility Score S (1 - average normalized deviations).

max_metric_std_dev.description: Maximum standard deviation of metrics across sensitivity seeds.

yield_std_dev.description: Standard deviation of yields across replicates.

flags.description: List of flags indicating issues (e.g., 'Model Substitution', 'Missing Replicate Data', 'Data Unavailable').

failure_details.description: Detailed error or failure information if applicable.
